pairs.description: Echinacea might reduce the effectiveness of immunosuppressants because of its potential immunostimulatory activity.
pairs.mechanism: Echinacea's potential immunostimulatory activity may oppose the immunosuppressive action of these drugs.

pairs.description: Echinacea might increase cytochrome P450 activity, which could reduce levels of some drugs metabolized by these enzymes.
pairs.mechanism: Echinacea might increase cytochrome P450 activity, thereby reducing levels of drugs metabolized by these enzymes.
